full_details: The first of the morning was stiff. At Uxbridge the corn was in, and the women gleaning did not look up. From a rise in the afternoon the smoke lay flat and brown along the river, Westminster to the Tower, and Hobbins said she wants everything by Thursday. At St Giles, walking, you said it into the noise: twenty-four days, one scene, the one the rest hangs from, and a house you cannot pay for. Gilbert was on the mounting-block at the Bell. You look like Father. The walking was folly, the barn was vanity, the twenty shillings was right. Then the news. The Spaniard was three days in Cornwall and is gone. Parishes are counting pikes. The marshal's men have been off the gates since the first week of August. The Queen came to Whitehall on Monday and went into Surrey this morning. Bread is no better. The Rose and the Theatre have bills up for Monday. Bartholomew Fair is cried for Sunday, and Gilbert will be behind a stall whether he likes it. Your father owes Sadler the baker. He had not told you. You paid Hobbins the two shillings, and you gave Gilbert the gloves your mother sent. You took a bed in the Bell, twopence, shared with a man from Coventry. The road back is nine shillings, all told.
one_sentence: You came through Uxbridge on your feet, heard three weeks of London from Gilbert in one breath, saw London's smoke from a rise, and paid Hobbins his two shillings at the Bell.
title: Gilbert's three weeks in one breath
